hints.title: Group Parsing into Choice Sets
hints.text: Parse the input string into sequential choice groups. Single letters become singleton lists, while bracketed elements {a,b,c} become sorted candidate lists.

hints.title: Lexicographical Choice Sorting
hints.text: Sorting character choices within each bracketed group ensures that standard depth-first expansion automatically generates strings in sorted order.

hints.title: Cartesian Product Generation
hints.text: Use recursion or product iteration across groups: pick one character from group 0, one from group 1, and so forth until reaching the end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unstructured string replacement generates duplicates and requires post-sorting.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-sorting group choices generates words in lexicographical order in optimal time.
